about: An index of extensions built on olimex-shield, in this repository or not. It is not a registry: an extension declares itself with extensions.declare() (apps/server/extensions.py) and registers the `olimex_shield.extensions` entry point. The bridge's extensions.discover() finds every installed one, every entry here with a `path` (no install needed) and every package in $OLIMEX_EXTENSIONS, and reports each with a status. An entry with a `path` and no other `repo` lives here, and tests/test_contract.py holds it to its package. `routes` lets the bridge answer 503 with the extension's status when it is absent or refused. Rules: docs/EXTENSIONS.md.

extensions.name: olimex-shield-ext-experimental
extensions.job: Serves the experimental analysis routes (lock-in, noise budget, atlas) as bridge routes.
